evidence.title: Cedar Dune Trading LLC receives compliance penalty
evidence.excerpt: The Fictional Commerce Authority imposed an administrative penalty on Cedar Dune Trading LLC for recordkeeping control failures. The notice names the company as the sanctioned party; it does not allege fraud or a criminal conviction.

evidence.title: Customer portal exposure reported at Cedar Dune Trading LLC
evidence.excerpt: Cedar Dune Trading LLC reported that its customer portal exposed account records during a security incident. An outside attacker was responsible; the report does not say the company committed an offence.

evidence.title: Cedar Dune director cited in personal tax matter
evidence.excerpt: Mira Vale, a director of Cedar Dune Trading LLC, received a personal tax penalty. The notice names Vale, not the company, as the party subject to the action.

evidence.title: Cedar Dune Logistics LLC charged in cargo case
evidence.excerpt: Cedar Dune Logistics LLC, a separate company with a different registration number, was charged in a cargo case. The article does not mention Cedar Dune Trading LLC.

evidence.title: Cedar Dune Trading LLC restructures workforce
evidence.excerpt: Cedar Dune Trading LLC announced ten layoffs during a routine restructuring. No misconduct, enforcement action, or allegation is described.

evidence.title: Anonymous review calls Cedar Dune Trading LLC a scam

evidence.title: Headline says Cedar Dune Trading LLC fined
evidence.excerpt: The headline says Cedar Dune Trading LLC was fined, but the cited Fictional Commerce Authority notice names two brokers, not Cedar Dune Trading LLC, as the penalized parties. The notice concerns trades in the company's securities.
